function.arguments: {"finding": "The site distribution is imbalanced between treatment and control groups: site_1 has 220 controls and 110 treatments, site_2 has 172 controls and 98 treatments, site_3 has 118 controls and 82 treatments. This imbalance suggests that treatment assignment is not random and is confounded with site. Therefore, a raw difference in proportions between treatment and control is not a valid estimate of the treatment effect — it is confounded by site.", "implication": "To estimate the treatment effect correctly, I must adjust for site. I will compute the response rate within each site, then compute the difference in proportions within each site, and then average them (weighted by group size) to get a site-stratified treatment effect. This is necessary to avoid confounding."}
function.name: note_finding
